station_name: Don Pedro Reservoir near La Grange, Calif.
township_range_section: SW¼ sec. 35, T. 2 S., R. 14 E.
notes: Sampled table is the lower one (Monthly elevation and contents, water year October 1949 to September 1950). 13 end-of-month rows (Sept. 30, 1949 to Sept. 30, 1950) x elevation and contents = 26 measurements. Change in contents during month (12 monthly values + calendar year 1949 + water year 1949-50 = 14) is computed from the contents column, counted only in n_variables. Location text also says: at Don Pedro Dam on Tuolumne River, 1 mile downstream from Rogers Creek and 5.5 miles upstream from La Grange. No county printed.
